title: Just got home to Loki,  he is feeling better
description:
just got home from work and let Loki out, he seems to be a little bit more energetic day-by-day he seems to be getting stronger and stronger that's my little fluff ball. I have to do something about his cages because he seems to be missing the little low profile litter box that I got him I think it's too small so I went out and got three bigger ones I'm going to tape them together because the little booger keeps on missing and Landing between the tray and the other tray, he has perfect aiming for that lol I still love him so I'm going to do everything in my power to try to get them to pee in a litter box now he's going to have 3
I love my fox!!!!
author: Loki the Red Fox
